senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טָבַל I) (act. verb) to sink, drown.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:13">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>לטוֹבְעוֹ</he> to drown him (sink his ship).
<cite ref="Gittin 56b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>טְבָעוֹ</he> He drowned him; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:3">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>טָבְעָה ספינתו וכ׳</he> if his ship went down &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 10b">Meg. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:5">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>מעשה ידי טוֹבְעִין וכ׳</he> my creatures (Egyptians) are perishing in the sea, and you want to sing?; a. e.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 120">Yalk. Gen. 120</cite> <he>ה׳ האבן</he> He made the stone sink down to the depth &c.; (<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 35:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXV</cite>, <he>וטָבְעָה האבן</he>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 91">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI</cite>, end <he>וטבע אותה</he>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 241:1">Yalk. Ex. 241</cite> <he>להַטְבִּיעַ את מצרים</he> to drown the Egyptians; a. e.
